purpose: The current seed is additive user/item IDs, under which request-context terms shared across a user's request cannot necessarily change candidate ordering. Literature is needed to resolve the material architecture choice for the only positively screened, leakage-safe feature group: whether a minimal interaction model is justified and which interaction structure is most appropriate under scarce experiment budget.
query: Literature on context-aware recommendation for within-user impression ranking with sparse categorical user_id, item_id, and request-context features (tab, hour, weekday), focusing on low-compute architectures such as factorization machines, field-aware interactions, or context-conditioned item scoring. Identify methods that make context affect within-user item ordering without using post-impression outcomes or future information.

purpose: The fixed objective is the mean of GAUC and nDCG@5, but the seed optimizes pointwise BCE and no measured baseline separates GAUC from nDCG@5 behavior. Literature is needed to resolve whether a ranking-aligned objective is a material next-experiment candidate, and to constrain any training construction to logged, temporally valid impressions.
query: Literature comparing pointwise binary cross-entropy and pairwise/listwise ranking objectives for implicit-feedback recommender evaluation using per-user AUC/GAUC and nDCG@5, especially under temporal holdout and small candidate sets. Seek practical guidance on whether changing the objective alone is likely to improve top-k ranking and how to avoid invalid negative sampling when all logged impressions are evaluation candidates.
